items.prompt:
The rate of a reaction is
A) how fast it happens
B) its color
C) its mass
D) its price

steps: Rate is the speed of a reaction.

items.prompt:
Reactions happen when particles
A) collide with enough energy
B) stay still
C) freeze
D) change color

Raising the temperature ____ a reaction.
A) speeds up
B) slows down
C) stops
D) freezes

A powder reacts faster than a lump because it has more
A) surface area
B) color
C) mass
D) price

steps: More surface area exposes more particles.

items.prompt:
Higher concentration speeds a reaction because particles collide more
A) frequently
B) rarely
C) slowly
D) quietly

A reaction in a warm room versus a fridge will be
A) faster in the warm room
B) faster in the fridge
C) the same
D) stopped in both
items.answer: A) faster in the warm room

steps: Warmer particles collide more, speeding the reaction.

items.prompt:
Both higher temperature and higher concentration speed a reaction because they
A) increase the number of effective collisions
B) decrease collisions
C) stop the reaction
D) change the color
items.answer: A) increase the number of effective collisions

steps: More effective collisions speed the reaction.

items.prompt:
Which change would SLOW a reaction?
A) Cooling it down
B) Heating it up
C) Grinding a solid to powder
D) Increasing concentration

steps: Cooling slows particle motion and collisions.
